messages:
Elena: Heads-up — Novacare onboarding: recurring tail latency spikes during multi-turn chat bursts. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/example/novacare/latency
Ravi: Are the spikes coming from long contexts or concurrency?
Elena: Mostly long contexts (~1.2k tokens) and a few 95th pct spikes ~1.2s/token. Renewal touchpoint next Tue; customer concerned about SLA.
Samir: Proposal: canary 10% to an int8-quantized variant (kernel tuned for KV cache) + prefix caching. Early wins: ~25% token latency reduction in staging. Example route policy:
```json
{"condition":"customer_id=='novacare' && rand()<0.1","model":"open-llama-13b-8q","fallback": ["open-llama-13b-16q", "redwood-small"]}
```
Samir: Command to apply (will run after approvals):
```
redwood route update --id route-762 --canary-model open-llama-13b-8q --canary-weight 0.1 --prefix-cache-ttl 300
```
Ravi: Ran local eval on their prompt set: int8 cuts p50/p95 token latency ~20%/25%, cost -40%, tiny uptick in token-level perplexity on 0.3% of prompts. Recommend run eval on customer corpus in prod canary.
Elena: Can we roll today if we set canary + monitoring alerts? I have approval from AE.
Samir: Yes — I'll stage the route change + add alert for perplexity regression and error-rate. Deploying canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary route update applied (route-762). Canary=10% -> open-llama-13b-8q. Rollout: https://deploys/redwood/route-762
Ravi: I'll run the automated eval against Novacare prompts and post numbers here. :thumbsup:
Elena: Thanks — scheduling renewal sync with these notes. Ping me once eval is in.
